rows.summary: The 2025 Item 19 is verbatim identical to the 2024 Item 19, retaining the franchisor's statement that it makes no financial performance representations and no substantive change was made.

Item 19 is substantively unchanged from 2017 to 2026: the franchisor continues to make no financial performance representations, retains the existing-outlet actual-records exception, and only the reporting contact details and typography changed.

The Item 19 financial performance representation disclosures are substantively unchanged from 2017 to 2023: both editions disclaim future and past financial performance representations, prohibit employee or representative representations, permit actual records for a purchased existing outlet, and require reporting any other received performance information or projections.

Item 19 is substantively identical across the 2017 and 2018 FDDs: both state that no financial performance representations are made, that employees and representatives are not authorized to make them, that actual records may be provided for an existing outlet being purchased, and that unauthorized financial performance information must be reported; the only apparent differences are OCR/formatting artifacts.

The 2018 Item 19 disclaimed all financial performance representations, while the 2026 Item 19 introduces a 2025 historical financial performance representation for franchised outlets with tercile and cumulative tables, defined metrics, outlet inclusion rules, and substantiation and disclaimer language.
